standard.summary: 启用 torch.compile 图缓存，跨 run 复用编译结果。
standard.whenToUse: 不确定时先保持默认，小步数短测后再调。
standard.avoidWhen: 与预检冲突或与其它互斥选项同时开启时。

standard_en.summary: Enables the torch.compile graph cache so compilation results are reused across runs.
standard_en.whenToUse: When unsure keep the default; run a short low-step test before changing it.
standard_en.avoidWhen: When it conflicts with preflight, or when a mutually exclusive option is enabled at the same time.

advanced.principle: 启用 torch.compile 图缓存，跨 run 复用编译结果。默认开启；关闭后每次冷启动重新编译。

advanced_en.principle: Enables the torch.compile graph cache, reusing compilation results across runs. On by default; turning it off recompiles on every cold start.
